name: instabox-manager
title: InstaBox Manager
description: Create, control and connect to your InstaBox cloud machines, run commands on them and manage their snapshots.
author: ridemountainpig

commands.name: manage-machines
commands.title: Manage Machines
commands.subtitle: InstaBox
commands.description: List your InstaBox machines, control their lifecycle, connect via SSH, open the desktop, and more.

commands.name: create-machine
commands.title: Create Machine
commands.subtitle: InstaBox
commands.description: Create a new InstaBox machine from a template or one of your snapshots.

commands.name: run-command
commands.title: Run Command
commands.subtitle: InstaBox
commands.description: Run a shell command on an InstaBox machine and see its output.

commands.name: manage-snapshots
commands.title: Manage Snapshots
commands.subtitle: InstaBox
commands.description: List, delete, and create machines from your InstaBox snapshots.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: An InstaBox API key (ibk_...). Create one on the API Keys page of the InstaBox dashboard.

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal App
preferences.description: The terminal used for SSH connections on macOS.

preferences.name: sshTokenTtl
preferences.title: SSH Token Lifetime
preferences.description: How long a new SSH login token stays valid.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: API URL
preferences.description: Only change this for a self-hosted InstaBox server.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
